photos.desc: Rheubarbariboletus armeniacus is a thermophilic species into the Boletaceae family that grows in Mediterranean areas. This specimen was found in a chestnut forest (Monte Rocca Romana, Lazio).
Parco naturale regionale di Bracciano-Martignano ( Q3895674 ) Fungo Rheubarbariboletus armeniacus nei boschi di cerri del Monte Rocca Romana, Lazio
